pages.text: Seeking Immortals contains multiple quest lines spanning the complete cultivation journey from mortal to ascension. Quest lines include $(l)main quests$(), $(l)sect quests$(), $(l)faction quests$(), and $(l)side quests$().

pages.title: Seven Mysteries Sect Tutorial
pages.text: The $(l)Seven Mysteries Sect quest line$() is the beginner tutorial, starting from the mortal stage.$(br2)Quest flow:$(li)Talk to $(l)Elder Mo$() and complete spiritual root test$(li)Join Seven Mysteries Sect, receive Yellow Dragon Manual$(li)Complete labor, submit 10 spiritual herbs$(li)Learn basic alchemy$(li)Discover the sect secret

pages.title: Seven Mysteries Quest (cont.)
pages.text: $(li)Investigate the secret room, obtain mysterious vial$(li)Use spirit liquid to ripen crops and report back$(li)Obtain evidence of elder corruption$(li)Choose branch: report, stay silent, or blackmail$(li)Escape during Heavenly Gang Alliance attack$(li)Head to Yue Nation to unlock follow-up sect lines$(br2)Use command $(l)/seeking_immortals quest$() to check progress.

pages.title: Main Story Chapters
pages.text: After Seven Mysteries, the main story has 6 chapters:$(br)$(l)Chapter 1: Sect Cultivation$() (Qi Refining → Foundation)$(br)$(l)Chapter 2: Foundation Secret Realm$() (Blood Forbidden Land)$(br)$(l)Chapter 3: Chaotic Sea$() (Foundation → Core Formation)$(br)$(l)Chapter 4: Great Jin$() (Core → Nascent Soul)$(br)$(l)Chapter 5: Deity Tribulation$() (Nascent → Deity)$(br)$(l)Chapter 6: Spirit Realm Ascension$() (Deity → Void+)

pages.title: Sect Quest Lines
pages.text: Each sect offers exclusive quests:$(li)$(l)Yellow Maple Valley$(): Alchemy and Blood Forbidden training$(li)$(l)Blade Transformation Workshop$(): Blade dao and intent$(li)$(l)Giant Sword Sect$(): Giant sword art and relic restoration$(li)$(l)Veiled Moon Sect$(): Illusion art and formation practice$(li)$(l)Heavenly Talisman Gate$(): Talisman mastery$(li)$(l)Thousand Bamboo Sect$(): Puppet art and Dayan technique

pages.title: Faction Quest Lines
pages.text: Different regions offer unique faction quests:$(li)$(l)Mulan-Tianlan War$(): Spell Masters vs Beast Tamers$(li)$(l)Star Palace Faction$(): Chaotic Sea patrols and enforcement$(li)$(l)Inverse Star Alliance$(): Smuggling, intelligence, resistance$(li)$(l)Six Demonic Sects$(): Ghost Spirit Gate, Hehuan Sect, etc.$(li)$(l)Great Jin Clans$(): Clan disputes and Kunwu treasures$(li)$(l)Tianyuan City$(): Merit system and Diyuan delving

pages.title: Secret Realm Quests
pages.text: 19 explorable secret realms, each with quest chains:$(li)$(l)Blood Forbidden Land$(): Foundation materials, Blood Jiao guardian$(li)$(l)Void Heaven Palace$(): Void key and ancient spirit treasures$(li)$(l)Kunwu Mountain$(): Seal fragments and puppet mechanisms$(li)$(l)Fallen Demon Valley$(): Demon qi purification, spatial rifts$(li)$(l)Nether River$(): Soul stones, ghost cultivation$(li)$(l)Diyuan Depths$(): Spirit vein shards, pressure trials

pages.title: Side & Special Quests
pages.text: Rich side quests beyond main story:$(li)$(l)Craft Mastery$(): Alchemy, refining, talisman, formation mastery$(li)$(l)Ghost Path$(): Underworld pilgrimage, ghost cultivation taboo$(li)$(l)Spirit Beast Puppet$(): Beast contracts and puppet furnace$(li)$(l)Eighteen Clan Pilgrimage$(): Fengyuan world exploration$(li)$(l)Barbarian King Hunt$(): King tokens and ancient beast cores$(br2)Each quest line offers unique rewards and story.
